name: Miniaturization Residue
summary: Miniaturization Residue is left on Feralas giants shrunk by Zorbin Fandazzle’s device. He studies it to improve his shrinking ray and asks for more at the Forgotten Coast docks.

sections.title: Residue from Giants
sections.body: Along the Forgotten Coast, Zorbin Fandazzle seeks residue from giants shrunk with his Ultra-Shrinker. Cliff Giants, Deep Striders, Land Walkers, Shore Striders and Wave Striders all yield it after the device has been used. Zorbin says the residue helps him keep his other zappers from exploding on their users.

faq.answer: Miniaturization Residue is found on Feralas giants after they have been shrunk with Zorbin’s Ultra-Shrinker.

aliases: who do I bring it to
faq.answer: Zorbin Fandazzle, at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, asks for Miniaturization Residue.
Zorbin studies the residue to help ensure his other shrinking devices do not explode on their users.
Cliff Giants, Deep Striders, Land Walkers, Shore Striders and Wave Striders in Feralas can yield residue after being shrunk.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may recognize Zorbin’s interest in residue as a way to improve his shrinking devices.
